answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the umber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A reef of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ferrous of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
